author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Phantom Blade Zero has sold 4 million (!) copies in just three days, and it's a sure bet we've seen the birth of a new franchise. Although it's a far cry from fellow Chinese-developed game with Eastern influence Black Myth: Wukong, which sold 10 million (!!) in three days, it's still a fantastic start to a game that is also resonating with critics. In other news, Nintendo has revealed the development team behind The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake: Entertainment Planning & Development Production Group No. 3. While not exactly a household name, they've been behind every major Zelda game for the past 30 years, so the remake is in good hands. And we’ve got a peek at the five immersive worlds of the all-new Universal Epic Universe, and one of its featured attractions – Stardust Racers, all at Universal Orlando Resort. 
Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.
title: Phantom Blade Zero Is the Next Big Thing - IGN Daily Fix

Meet Gratia and learn about this character in this new Silver Palace trailer for this upcoming open-world detective action RPG. Silver Palace will be available on PC, Android, iOS, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on December 14, 2026.

Inspired by Victorian aesthetics, Silver Palace brings to life a bustling metropolis powered by a mysterious substance known as "Silverium." author: IGN
description:
Chrono Odyssey is an upcoming time-manipulating action-MMORPG due out in Q2 2027 for PC and consoles. This video offers a first look at Paladin battling Mirajin, a new Chrono Gate boss. It also showcases strategic combat using two key Chronotector movements, Replicate and Isolation. Paladin, unveiled for the first time, is a class that wields a long spear and shield. The footage showcases chained attacks with the spear, as well as a skill that summons a massive spear to deal damage to the boss. It also highlights Paladin using its shield to block incoming attacks and mitigate damage. 

Replicate allows players to temporarily recreate the combat skills of bosses they have previously defeated to attack their enemies, while Isolation freezes an enemy in time for a limited period, restricting its movement. The footage demonstrates how players can use these abilities to control enemy movements and create openings for attacks, highlighting the strategic possibilities of time manipulation in
title: Chrono Odyssey: Uncut Chrono Gate Boss Fight Gameplay
